title: The Junior Classics
about: A library for children in ten volumes (1912): fairy and wonder tales, folk tales and myths, tales from Greece and Rome, heroes of chivalry, old-fashioned tales, stories of courage, animal and nature stories, and poems. Read aloud.
subject: reading
credit: Edited by William Patten (1912). Recordings by LibriVox volunteers, in the public domain.
